components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Flat primary call-to-action for reading note expansion and specimen isolation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: Trough-backed secondary button for view resets, inline lab shortcuts, and modal actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14)); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--bg-trough, #eaece9); color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-accent, rgba(12, 102, 126, 0.48)); background: var(--bg-active, rgba(12, 102, 126, 0.12)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Clinical Mode Pill
components.description: Single-row ARIA tab pill switching across the 5 clinical modalities.
components.css: .ds-mode-trough { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-trough, #eaece9); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14)); } .ds-mode-pill { position: relative; appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #434c56); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 11px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-mode-pill:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); background: var(--bg-hover, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.06)); } .ds-mode-pill[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--bg-surface-solid, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); } .ds-mode-pill[aria-selected="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-inline: 11px; inset-block-end: 2px; border-block-end: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-mode-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: System Filter Chip

components.css: .ds-chip-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14)); background: var(--bg-trough, #eaece9); color: var(--text-secondary, #434c56); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 11px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); border-color: var(--border-accent, rgba(12, 102, 126, 0.48)); } .ds-chip.active { background: var(--bg-active, rgba(12, 102, 126, 0.12)); border-color: var(--border-accent, rgba(12, 102, 126, 0.48)); color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card-glass { position: relative; width: 388px; padding: 15px 18px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--bg-surface, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.91)); color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(135%); box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating, 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.06), 0 6px 14px rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.06), 0 16px 32px rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.08)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .ds-card-glass::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1px; background: var(--glass-border-grad, linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.22), rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.06) 55%, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14))); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-badge { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); } .ds-tabs { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary, #434c56); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-lead { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.62; color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); } .ds-telemetry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr); gap: 12px; padding: 9px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14)); } .ds-tkey { display: block; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #434c56); } .ds-tval { display: block; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 192px; height: 34px; padding: 0 6px 0 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-trough, #eaece9); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14)); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-input-search input { width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); caret-color: var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-input-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary, #434c56); } .ds-input-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-search-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; color: var(--text-secondary, #434c56); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.css: .ds-pin-chip { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(20, 24, 28, 0.14)); background: var(--bg-surface, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.91)); color: var(--text-primary, #14181c); padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .ds-pin-chip.selected { border-color: var(--border-accent, rgba(12, 102, 126, 0.48)); background: var(--bg-surface-elevated, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97)); font-weight: 600; } .ds-pin-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pin-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-primary, #0c667e); flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Inner Ear 3D Lab rejects crowded multi-pane surgical cockpits and fragmented corner popups in favor of an architectural full-bleed WebGL2 specimen stage paired with a single unified left-hand Note & Lab Sidebar (#note-sidebar). Whether rendered in obsidian studio darkroom mode or warm drafting-paper light mode, the 27-part Right-Anterior-Superior (RAS) labyrinth occupies center stage (>= 85% unobstructed area at rest across desktop, tablet, and mobile), while deep reading and clinical lab charts expand cleanly inside that single left column and dynamically shift 3D camera framing (setViewOffset) rightward into open space.

Both themes share identical spatial geometry, typographic hierarchy, and stereotaxic truth, switching polarity through native CSS color-scheme and light-dark() tokens with manual persistence and @supports fallbacks. Every surface—from AgX tone-mapped WebGL2 translucency to custom geometric stroke icons, occluded 3D label pins, and canvas-rendered CT/VNG/surgical plots—maintains generous typography (16px note prose, >= 13px controls) without visual noise.
keyCharacteristics: Anti-Cockpit >= 85% clear WebGL2 stage invariant enforced in resting compact state across 1440×900, 1280×800, 768×1024, and 390×844 viewports in both themes.
Native OS + manual dual polarity pairing frosted dark glassroom surfaces with light technical drafting paper and 7px corner L-brackets.

One-Side Progressive Disclosure (collapsed pill -> compact 280px preview -> expanded 388px Note/Lab reader -> 476px Further Read <details>; mobile bottom reader sheet above #bottom-bar) paired with dynamic setViewOffset 3D camera panning and shifted --dock-shift-x clearance.
Zero-GC WebGL2 loop synced in real time to resolved theme polarity so both bone shells and fluid membranes remain crisp against dark studio depth and warm daylight paper.

rules.name: The Polarity-Paired Canvas Rule
rules.body: Every surface, border, and WebGL2 material parameter resolves synchronously across light and dark via light-dark() and meta[name="color-scheme"], never leaving dark chrome stranded over light paper or bright pastel membranes washed out on #f5f5f3.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Semantic hues (amber otoliths, crimson breach alerts and Right Ear audiogram markers, emerald clearance bands) appear strictly on anatomical markers, physiological thresholds, and active accents so surrounding chrome remains neutral.

rules.name: The Minimum Legible Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls, pills, 3D pins, and sidebar telemetry stay at or above 13px (0.8125rem) while expanded note body copy sets at 16px (1rem)—paired with a 12px minimum floor for dense SVG/Canvas scientific axes.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Stereotaxic coordinates, Greenwood millimeter distances, Hounsfield/depth readouts, and angular slider values always render in ui-monospace with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so scrubbing sliders never jitters adjacent layout.

rules.name: The Anti-Cockpit 85% Stage Rule
rules.body: Combined foreground chrome must leave at least 85% of the viewport clear to the WebGL2 specimen in initial compact resting states across 1440×900, 1280×800, 768×1024, and 390×844 viewports.

rules.name: The Single-Sidebar Consolidation Rule
rules.body: All reading levels, <details> accordions, and mode-specific lab visualizations consolidate inside the single expandable #note-sidebar, eliminating right-edge strips and multi-corner overlapping drawers.

rules.name: The Flat-Action Rule
rules.body: Action buttons, filter chips, and dock controls stay shadow-free inside already elevated cards and docks, communicating hover and selection solely through 1px border and fill shifts instead of stacking redundant drop shadows.

rules.name: The Masked Glass Edge Rule
rules.body: Frosted floating containers render a 1px directional top-left sheen border via mask-composite: exclude pseudo-elements while falling back cleanly to system canvas high-contrast outlines under forced-colors: active.

rules.name: The Hairline Divider Rule
rules.body: Internal card sections, telemetry metrics, and 27-part lists separate purely with 1px horizontal rules rather than nesting shadowed sub-cards inside floating drawers.

dos: Do protect at least 85% clear WebGL2 canvas area in resting states across desktop, tablet, and mobile in both light and dark states (The Anti-Cockpit 85% Stage Rule).
Do resolve every CSS surface, shadow, and WebGL2 shader pigment synchronously via color-scheme: light dark and light-dark() with explicit @supports not fallbacks.
Do maintain 16px expanded note body prose and keep interactive controls/pins at >= 13px (12px minimum for SVG/Canvas plot axes) with tabular numerals on millimeter/frequency metrics.
Do consolidate Note reading, Further Read <details>, and clinical Lab charts inside #note-sidebar while shifting 3D camera setViewOffset and dock clearance dynamically.
Do terminate custom linear-space GLSL shaders with Three.js #include <tonemapping_fragment> and #include <colorspace_fragment> under AgXToneMapping.
donts: Don't place eyebrows, uppercase category kickers, or badge ribbons above <h1> hero lockups.
Don't stack persistent sidebars, duplicate drop shadows on buttons inside cards, or boxed sub-cards inside floating drawers.
Don't replace custom geometric vector SVGs with Unicode emojis or external icon font dependencies in header/tool chrome.
Don't allocate DOM pin nodes, Three.js vectors, geometries, or materials inside requestAnimationFrame.
Don't ship global * CSS resets that leak into WebGL/canvas or third-party primitives.
